problem: mllm 缺少 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的手机 CPU 推理路径。
Qwen3.5-0.8B needed a mobile CPU inference path.
change: 接入模型结构、权重转换与运行入口，将 GDN 循环状态和注意力 KV 状态接入混合模型执行。
Adds the model, conversion and runner, including recurrent GDN and attention cache state.
scope: 针对 0.8B 文本模型；多模态及 4B 扩展由后续 PR 单独完成。
The 0.8B text path is distinct from later multimodal and 4B extensions.

problem: 已有 0.8B 路径还不能直接承担 Qwen3.5-4B 的模型规模与运行约束。
The existing 0.8B path needed a separate Qwen3.5-4B model contract.
change: 补充 4B 配置、转换和手机 CPU 运行支持，复用混合注意力与 GDN 执行基础。
Adds 4B configuration, conversion and mobile CPU execution on the hybrid attention foundation.
scope: 这里是 4B 文本支持；不把后续 #698 的视觉能力计入本 PR。
This is text support; the later visual extension belongs to #698.

problem: GDN depthwise causal convolution 的标量计算增加了 ARM 推理开销。
Scalar GDN depthwise causal convolution added ARM inference overhead.
change: 为 AArch64 卷积路径加入向量化，围绕通道计算与卷积历史状态优化已有 Kernel。
Vectorizes the existing AArch64 convolution path while retaining its history-state contract.
scope: 优化对象是 GDN 卷积；不能由单算子结果推导整个模型的加速倍数。
A convolution-kernel optimization, not a claim of equivalent full-model speedup.

problem: GDN recurrence 的并行 lane 上限限制了已有 CPU 执行路径。
The GDN recurrence path capped parallel lanes at four.
change: 将 lane cap 从 4 提高到 8，并修复验证暴露的 splitTask 悬空引用；任务按独立状态区间划分。
Raises the lane cap to eight and fixes a splitTask dangling-reference bug exposed by validation, keeping task state regions disjoint.
scope: 这是特定执行参数的优化，不是新的 GDN 算法；收益依赖工作负载和设备。
A workload-dependent scheduling change, not a new GDN algorithm.

problem: 文本模型不能直接处理图像中的视觉信息。
The text-only model could not consume visual information.
change: 为 Qwen3.5-0.8B 加入单图预处理、视觉编码、视觉嵌入接入和多模态位置编码，使图像进入生成流程。
Adds single-image preprocessing, vision encoding, embedding injection and multimodal position handling for Qwen3.5-0.8B.
scope: 单图 CPU 路径与多图、视频能力分别验证；不将图像演示泛化为所有视觉任务精度。
Single-image CPU support is separate from multi-image and video extensions.

problem: 多张图片需要保持顺序、各自的位置编码和视觉注意力隔离。
Multiple images require ordering, positional alignment and independent visual attention.
change: 支持重复 image_path 参数，逐图 resize 和编码，再按提示词顺序拼接视觉嵌入并检查图像 span。
Encodes each image separately, then joins embeddings in prompt order with validated spans and image grids.
scope: PR 包含手机双图演示及单图回归；逐图编码不等于把所有 patch 混在一次视觉注意力中。
Includes phone demonstrations and single-image regression coverage; image attention remains isolated.

problem: 静态图片入口无法表达短视频的时间顺序。
A still-image interface does not represent temporal ordering.
change: 为 Qwen3.5-0.8B 接入有界短视频 CPU 路径，把视频帧、时间信息和视觉输入组织进生成请求。
Adds a bounded short-video CPU path for Qwen3.5-0.8B, organizing frames and temporal information for generation.
scope: 默认 decoder 为 none，H.264 MP4 参考后端需外部依赖；帧数和输入容量有界，不支持任意长视频。
Decoder defaults to none; the optional H.264 MP4 backend needs external dependencies. Frame and input sizes are bounded.

problem: 4B 视觉塔的层数和宽度不同，不能简单套用 0.8B 多模态配置。
The 4B vision tower differs from the 0.8B geometry.
change: 支持 4B 的 24 层、1024 隐藏维视觉塔；新增独立多模态配置与 W4A32 转换规则，保持 0.8B 校验。
Adds its 24-layer, width-1024 contract and separate multimodal conversion settings without weakening 0.8B validation.
scope: PR 展示单图、多图和有界短视频手机结果；它扩展已有路径，没有另造多模态运行时。
Extends existing image, multi-image and bounded-video paths; phone demonstrations are reported in the PR.

problem: Ling 混合 KDA、Gated MLA 与 MoE，不能直接复用普通 Transformer 图。
Ling mixes KDA, gated MLA and MoE rather than a conventional Transformer stack.
change: 注册 KimiDeltaAttention 算子和 CPU Kernel；卷积复用既有算子，Gated MLA 由现有算子组合，接入转换与文本生成。
Adds a registered KDA operation and CPU kernel, reusing existing convolution and composing MLA from existing operations.
scope: 新增的是 KDA，不是新 MLA 或卷积 Kernel；范围是指定 Ling-3.0-tiny 检查点的文本 CPU 支持。
Pinned Ling-3.0-tiny text support; this does not introduce a new MLA or convolution kernel.

problem: 按 query head 重复存储 K/V 会放大 GQA 模型的缓存占用。
Replicating K/V across query heads inflates GQA cache storage.
change: 接入 MiniCPM5-1B，并引入原生 KV-head 缓存和正式 GQA decode 算子；缓存与请求状态由模型层管理。
Adds MiniCPM5-1B, native KV-head storage and a registered GQA decode operation with explicit cache ownership.
scope: PR 区分主机算子测试与保留 Kernel 的历史设备结果；不是 PagedAttention，也不将旧设备结果当作新包装层复测。
Not PagedAttention. Host operation checks and retained-kernel device results have different revision boundaries.

problem: LFM2.5 的短卷积与全注意力交替，需要独立历史状态和 KV 槽位。
LFM2.5 interleaves short convolutions and full attention with different state needs.
change: 实现 30 层模型、分词、W4A32 转换和生成入口，管理 22 份卷积历史与 8 个注意力 KV 槽，注册模型计算算子。
Adds the 30-layer text model, tokenizer, conversion and runner, with 22 convolution histories and eight KV slots.
scope: 是指定 LFM2.5-2.6B 文本模型的 ARM 路径；状态重置和生成验证不等于所有模型复用该优化都有效。
Scoped to the pinned LFM2.5-2.6B ARM path; its state and generation checks do not generalize to every model.

problem: 模型直接调用后端 GDN Kernel，绕过了框架统一的算子与 IR 接口。
Model code called GDN backend kernels directly, bypassing the framework boundary.
change: 注册 GatedDeltaRule，复用 CausalDepthwiseConv1D；将循环状态显式作为输入输出，并按 Kernel、算子、模型分层组织测试。
Registers GatedDeltaRule, reuses causal convolution and makes recurrent state explicit across public operations and IR.
scope: 重点是框架集成和状态契约，不把既有 Kernel 重构描述成新的性能突破。
A runtime integration and state-contract refactor, not a new kernel speedup.

problem: 模型契约测试与 CPU Kernel 测试混放，缺少独立 GQA Kernel 对照。
Model-contract and CPU-kernel tests were mixed, with a missing direct GQA kernel oracle.
change: 把 MiniCPM5 配置、分词和模型测试迁到 tests/models，补充 CTest 注册、设备配置路径覆盖和 GQA Kernel 测试。
Moves MiniCPM5 tests into the model suite and adds CTest registration, device path overrides and GQA kernel coverage.
scope: 这是测试组织与覆盖补齐，不是新增模型能力或推理性能优化。
Test organization and coverage, not a new inference capability or speedup.

problem: 各模型分别拼接聊天提示词，难以统一工具、模板参数和特殊内容的语义。
Per-model prompt assembly made chat-template semantics hard to maintain.
change: 引入 ChatPreprocessor 与模型级 legacy/Jinja 选择，使用固定版本 jinja.cpp 并迁移首批模型，对照 Transformers 模板结果。
Adds ChatPreprocessor with legacy/Jinja selection, a pinned template engine and model migrations checked against Transformers.
scope: 基础接口和模型迁移共同组成此 PR；默认路径保持字节稳定，不意味着任意 Jinja 模板已兼容。
The foundation and migrations belong together; byte-stable defaults do not imply universal Jinja compatibility.

problem: MiniCPM5-2B 的层数和维度不同，错误配置需要在生成前被识别。
MiniCPM5-2B needs its own geometry and model/config mismatch checks.
change: 新增 2B 运行配置及 KAI W4A32 转换规则，保留 1B 模型并检查权重与配置匹配。
Adds size-specific runtime and KAI W4A32 conversion settings while preserving 1B support.
scope: 这是模型规模扩展；模型图、GQA Kernel、分词器和运行时线程机制复用已有实现。
A model-size extension; it reuses the graph, GQA kernel, tokenizer and runtime threading.

problem: Spark 的滑动/全局注意力混合、逐头门控与两种 RoPE 几何需要精确建模。
Spark combines sliding/full attention, headwise gates and two RoPE geometries.
change: 实现 Spark-X2.5-1.7B 的模型、分词、转换和单轮生成；用显式选项扩展 GELU、Sigmoid 与 GQA，保持旧默认行为。
Adds its model, tokenizer, converter and generation runner, extending existing operations through explicit options.
scope: 覆盖 FP32 与 ARM W4A32 路径；是否合并以状态标记为准，不能把提交评审等同正式发布。
FP32 and ARM W4A32 paths are scoped separately; submission is not the same as a release.

problem: 内存描述符误继承寄存器张量的二次幂约束，导致 3、5、6 级流水线无法编译。
Memory descriptors incorrectly inherited power-of-two register-tensor restrictions.
change: 拆出正静态形状的内存描述符类型，并逐槽初始化 close tag，避免 native lowering 再次构造非法寄存器张量。
Separates descriptor shape validation and initializes close tags per slot, removing the restriction at both compiler layers.
scope: PR 报告 H20 六级真实算子验证；没有放宽普通寄存器张量规则，也不会自动修改用户 stage 数。
Reports an H20 six-stage kernel check; register-tensor rules and user stage choices remain unchanged.

problem: 绝对迭代索引反复展开除法和取模，丢失了顺序循环可递推的游标信息。
Absolute iteration indices repeatedly expand division and modulo in sequential loops.
change: 新增携带 stage 与 phase 的 pipe_cursor，通过递增、回绕和翻转推进，同时保留旧迭代索引接口。
Introduces a loop-carried stage/phase cursor advanced by increment, wrap and phase toggle.
scope: 必须由 Kernel 显式采用；指令减少不能直接等同延迟减少，PR 的匹配实验分别报告两者。
Opt-in only; fewer instructions and lower latency are distinct outcomes in the matched experiment.

problem: 持久 CTA 切换输出 tile 时重置代际，会让深流水线等待错误 barrier phase。
Persistent CTAs reset pipeline generations between output tiles, risking the wrong barrier phase.
change: 把 X/Y 缓冲与 barrier 改为一个多字段 typed pipe，并跨输出 tile 保持连续的逻辑迭代和代际。
Unifies X/Y storage and barriers in a typed pipe and keeps logical iterations continuous across tiles.
scope: 恢复 Hopper FP8 einsum 的 stage-8 路径；性能比较限定 H20 代表形状及相同 CUDA Graph 测量方式。
Restores stage eight for Hopper FP8 einsum; performance comparisons are tied to the matched H20 workload.

problem: cuLA 需要与自身接口和状态约定一致的 Hopper GDN prefill 后端。
cuLA needed a Hopper GDN prefill path matching its API and state conventions.
change: 移植上游 512 线程 CuTe DSL GDN 算法并保留来源署名，接入 packed 序列、可选 gate 与初始/最终状态。
Ports the upstream 512-thread CuTe DSL algorithm with provenance, integrating packed sequences, optional gates and recurrent state.
scope: 属于 Gated DeltaNet，不与 Lightning Attention 或 GDN2 的实现、性能结果混用。
Gated DeltaNet is distinct from Lightning Attention and GDN2; their results are not interchangeable.

problem: 循环注意力 prefill 需要同时处理矩阵计算、跨 chunk 状态和变长序列。
Recurrent-attention prefill combines matrix work, cross-chunk state and variable-length sequences.
change: 实现 SM90 CuTe DSL 流水线，使用 TMA/WGMMA 与寄存器中的 FP32 状态，处理 packed 尾块和持久调度。
Builds an SM90 CuTe DSL pipeline with TMA/WGMMA, register-resident FP32 state and packed-tail handling.
scope: 2.89× 是指定 H20 BF16 prefill 主测试集相对 FLA 的几何平均结果，不是端到端 serving 加速。
The reported 2.89× is a specified H20 BF16 kernel-suite result versus FLA, not serving speedup.

problem: GDN2 融合 prefill 既要减少中间步骤，也要避免合法衰减输入使指数计算溢出。
Fused GDN2 prefill must also avoid exponent overflow for valid decay inputs.
change: 实现 packed SM90 GDN2，并对 chunk 内因子做分块重基准化；加入独立逐 token 参考及边界、极端衰减测试。
Adds packed SM90 GDN2 with blockwise-rebased factors and independent tokenwise, boundary and adversarial references.
scope: 公开修订已否定早期溢出版本的 2.379×；当前报告是五行 H20 测试的 2.165×，不外推到全部输入或 serving。
The rejected 2.379× revision is superseded by a reported 2.165× on five H20 cases, not all inputs or serving.

problem: 分开的 Gate/Up、GeGLU 与量化步骤会产生 BF16 中间张量和额外 launch。
Separate projection, GeGLU and quantization steps create intermediates and extra launches.
change: 为 Thor SM110 固定 pi0.5 MLP 形状融合投影、激活折叠及 NVFP4 输出，直接供后续 down projection 使用。
Fuses Gate/Up projection, activation folding and NVFP4 output for fixed pi0.5 shapes on Thor SM110.
scope: 这是显式启用的底层 Kernel 草案；没有修改模型默认分发、权重加载或转换流程。
An opt-in low-level kernel proposal; default model dispatch and weight conversion are not changed.

problem: Qwen3.5 的 MoE、共享专家和 GDN 输出分别归约，不能直接套用单一路径的序列并行。
Qwen3.5 reduces routed experts, shared experts and GDN outputs at separate boundaries.
change: 每层生成统一目标 sharding，将其传给两个专家分支、注意力输出、路由、token mask 与残差，按阈值启用 scatter。
Threads one per-layer target sharding through projections, routing, token masks and residuals with threshold-gated scattering.
scope: 重点是混合 GDN+MoE 的布局一致性；不能把单一拓扑测试推广成所有并行配置的收益。
Scoped to the hybrid path; one topology does not establish benefits for every parallel configuration.

problem: EP16 下 2032-token bucket 每设备分到 127 行，违反 BF16 MoE 的 tile 对齐要求。
An EP16 bucket of 2032 tokens produces 127 local rows, violating BF16 MoE tile alignment.
change: 分离逻辑与 launch 长度，在设备内补齐 tokens、路由 ID 和权重，再裁回逻辑输出；补齐行不路由到任何专家。
Separates logical and launch extents, pads tokens and routing locally, then slices outputs back to their logical shape.
scope: 已合法形状不增加 pad；修复预编译形状问题，不修改调度器对外 bucket 或宣称数值精度提升。
Legal shapes remain untouched; this fixes compilation alignment rather than changing scheduler buckets or accuracy.

problem: JAX 升级后严格检查 shard_map，原来被隐式修正的分片问题暴露出来。
Stricter JAX shard_map checks exposed formerly implicit layout fixes.
change: 提出 0.9.2 / libtpu 升级，调整多个后端 API 和分片推导，并强化 LoRA batch 元数据与槽位校验。
Proposes the 0.9.2/libtpu migration with backend compatibility work and explicit LoRA batching contracts.
scope: 这是较早的综合升级方案；最终 0.10.2 迁移见 #1461，不能将两份提案重复算成两次最终交付。
An earlier broad proposal; the final 0.10.2 migration is #1461, not a second instance of the same delivery.

problem: 按可整除性猜测 sharding，无法代表数组在运行或 tracing 时的真实布局。
Divisibility heuristics cannot establish an array’s actual sharding.
change: 抽出 effective_axis，读取实际 NamedSharding 或 tracer sharding，返回该维度是否确实采用目标轴。
Adds effective_axis to inspect concrete or tracer sharding and identify the partition axis actually used.
scope: 该 PR 只增加工具与测试、没有调用者；不能单独宣称已修复所有后端。
A standalone utility with no callers in this PR; it does not by itself repair every backend.

problem: FlashAttention 给复制的辅助数组声明分片 in_specs，触发新版 JAX 编译错误。
FlashAttention declared sharded specs for replicated auxiliary arrays.
change: 根据实际输入布局推导 FlashAttention 的输入输出规格，并补充读取分片的 helper。
Derives its boundary specs from actual input layouts and adds a sharding helper.
scope: 这是 #1057 拆出的局部方案，后被 #1461 替代；最终方案保留显式生产契约并修复生产端。
A narrower proposal from #1057, superseded by #1461’s explicit-contract and producer-fix approach.

problem: JAX 0.10.2 的 API 变化和严格布局检查暴露 EAGLE3 权重生产端及测试 fixture 问题。
JAX 0.10.2 exposed EAGLE3 producer-layout defects and mismatched test fixtures.
change: 直接升级至 0.10.2，修复 v_proj 与量化 scale 布局，迁移 Pallas/mesh API，并使测试拓扑匹配生产输入。
Upgrades dependencies and APIs, repairs v_proj/scale layouts and aligns backend fixtures with production inputs.
scope: 不使用通用消费端 reshard 掩盖问题；TPU 后端、精度和 serving 检查有各自范围，本页不重新跑实验。
Avoids a generic consumer reshard workaround; TPU correctness and serving results have separate scopes.

problem: PyTorch 对非 1 维度 squeeze 应保持输入不变，前端却无条件生成 squeeze。
PyTorch squeeze on a non-unit dimension should be a no-op.
change: 在静态维度已知时过滤非单位维度，覆盖单轴及多轴输入，动态维度保持保守处理。
Filters statically known non-unit dimensions before lowering, including multi-axis inputs.
scope: 回归针对 no-op 语义与导入 IR；不将消除冗余算子夸大为通用性能提升。
Regression coverage targets semantics and imported IR, not a general performance claim.

problem: opset 低于所有支持版本时，负索引会误选最新 converter，悄悄使用不兼容语义。
An opset below every supported version could select the newest converter through negative indexing.
change: 改为显式筛选不高于模型 opset 的实现；没有兼容版本时报告最低支持版本。
Filters compatible versions explicitly and rejects unsupported minimum versions.
scope: 此条未合并，且 diff 含其他前端改动；同主题合并记录是 #18911，不重复计为已采用修复。
This unmerged record includes other frontend changes; the merged same-topic record is #18911.

problem: 低 opset 的 ReduceMean 等算子可能误用新版本接口，产生错误形状而不报错。
Older operators could be routed to incompatible newer implementations without a clear error.
change: 修正 converter 版本选择，增加合法版本和低于最低版本的回归测试。
Fixes converter selection and adds supported-version and below-minimum regression cases.
scope: 解决版本路由错误，不意味着补齐所有旧 opset 算子的实现；不支持时明确拒绝。
Correct routing does not implement every historical opset; unsupported versions fail explicitly.

problem: Relax 缺少 affine_grid 接口，已有 TOPI 计算难以直接供前端使用。
Relax lacked an affine_grid interface over the existing TOPI computation.
change: 补齐 C++/Python 注册、类型推导和 legalization，接入 PyTorch/ONNX，并转换网格输出布局。
Adds registration, inference, legalization and PyTorch/ONNX import with output-layout conversion.
scope: 范围限 2D 且 align_corners=True；PR 报告算子、降级和前端测试，不能声称完整 3D 支持。
Limited to 2D and align_corners=True; reported operator and frontend tests do not establish 3D support.

problem: 目标检测后处理需要筛除低分框和经典 NMS，现有多类别接口不能覆盖全部组合需求。
Detection post-processing needed score compaction and classic NMS primitives.
change: 加入 get_valid_counts 与 classic NMS 的注册、TOPI、降级和 NumPy 对照，检查静态属性范围。
Adds Relax/TOPI implementations, legalization, NumPy references and static attribute checks.
scope: 经典 NMS 与 all_class_non_max_suppression 分开；动态元数据的属性校验不超出静态可知范围。
Classic and all-class NMS remain distinct; validation is bounded by available shape metadata.

problem: ONNX Optional 值和微软域 MatMulInteger16 缺少对应导入表达。
ONNX Optional values and Microsoft-domain MatMulInteger16 lacked import support.
change: 用显式空 Optional 标记处理创建、判断、解包，补充 TYPE_PROTO 解析及整数矩阵乘转换。
Adds an explicit empty-Optional sentinel, type parsing, unwrapping and integer-matmul conversion.
scope: 覆盖空值拒绝、结构和数值测试；Optional 是导入期表示，不应理解为任意运行时对象系统。
Tests cover empty-value rejection, IR and numeric behavior; Optional handling is an import representation.

problem: Unsqueeze、Squeeze 和 Slice 对动态轴或运行时切片参数支持不足。
Unsqueeze, Squeeze and Slice had gaps for dynamic axes and slice parameters.
change: 提出运行时 shape 构造、动态 strided_slice 及重复轴、零步长检查。
Proposes runtime shape construction, dynamic slicing and checks for duplicate axes and zero steps.
scope: 该条是未合并方案；同主题另有 #18955，页面保留过程记录但不按已采用能力计数。
An unmerged proposal, separate from #18955; retained as process history rather than adopted functionality.

problem: 动态形状操作需要正确计算输出形状，同时保持常量路径简洁。
Shape operators need runtime shape handling without complicating constant paths.
change: 动态轴通过 shape tensor 和 reshape 降级；常量 Unsqueeze 合并为一次 reshape，并补充标量与非法参数测试。
Lowers dynamic axes through shape tensors and reshape, simplifying constant Unsqueeze to one reshape.
scope: 动态路径仍要求可知的 rank/轴长度；不是无限制动态形状支持。
Known rank/axis-length constraints remain; scalar and invalid-parameter regressions bound the support.

problem: TFLite 检测模型的自定义 DETECTION_POSTPROCESS 缺少 Relax 转换。
TFLite detection models lacked DETECTION_POSTPROCESS conversion.
change: 连接边框解码、NMS 和输出重排，并解析类别数、最大检测数及缩放参数。
Connects box decoding, NMS and output alignment with custom-option parsing.
scope: 这是初始后处理接入；后续量化 SSD 类别与重复 softmax 修复归属 #20291。
An initial integration; later quantized SSD class and softmax corrections belong to #20291.

problem: 矩阵对角线和稀疏转稠密 converter 调用了不存在的 Relax 算子。
Diagonal and sparse-to-dense converters called nonexistent Relax operators.
change: 改用 call_dps_packed 形式引用 TOPI 名称，补齐输出类型信息和三个导入测试。
Changes them to call_dps_packed references with explicit output information and import tests.
scope: 本 PR 的导入测试通过不等于已证明对应 packed 函数可运行；不能仅凭结构覆盖宣称端到端闭环。
Passing import tests alone does not prove the referenced packed functions execute end to end.

problem: DENSIFY 在导入期返回预取常量，下游却按普通运行时算子处理，导致空返回值或权重读取错误。
DENSIFY materializes constants during import, conflicting with ordinary runtime handling.
change: 在 normalize 前处理空返回，优先读取 prefetched 值，并修正全连接及转置卷积权重接入。
Handles empty converter returns and prefetched values, including downstream weight consumers.
scope: DENSIFY 是转换期稀疏权重展开；不是新增运行时稀疏计算 Kernel。
Import-time sparse-weight materialization, not a runtime sparse-compute kernel.

problem: soft-NMS 会衰减分数并改变候选顺序，不能沿用硬 NMS 的分数读取方式。
Soft-NMS changes scores and candidate order, unlike hard suppression.
change: 贯通 sigma 与阈值属性，返回衰减后分数、重新选择当前最优候选，并对齐 LiteRT 高斯衰减语义。
Threads sigma/threshold attributes through the stack and aligns decayed-score selection with LiteRT.
scope: 覆盖 Relax/TOPI 和 TFLite 路径；这是检测后处理语义修复，不是检测模型精度训练改进。
A post-processing semantic change with operator/frontend coverage, not improved model training accuracy.

problem: 运行时 dims 和 size_splits 无法被只接受常量的 FILL/SPLIT_V 路径处理。
Constant-only FILL/SPLIT_V paths rejected runtime dimensions and split sizes.
change: 将 dims 转成 Relax shape；将动态 split 拆为 cumsum 和动态切片，并以输出 tuple 数量确定分支数。
Converts dimensions to shapes and uses cumulative sizes plus dynamic slicing with model-defined output arity.
scope: 测试覆盖导入和编译契约；输出数量来自模型元数据，不靠猜测动态 size_splits 长度。
Import/compile coverage preserves the model’s output count instead of guessing dynamic tensor length.

problem: 反向 STRIDED_SLICE 的 end_mask 边界可能漏掉下标 0。
Reverse slicing could omit index zero due to end-mask handling.
change: 修正负步长的排他下界，加入非单位步长、反向切片及静态 SPLIT_V 回归。
Corrects the exclusive lower bound for negative strides and adds slicing/static-split regressions.
scope: 动态 FILL/SPLIT_V 已由 #19433 单独处理；这里不重复归入该能力。
Dynamic FILL/SPLIT_V belongs to #19433, not this change.

problem: TFLite 随机算子需要种子与运行时形状支持，而现有转换不完整。
TFLite random operators needed seeded calls and runtime shape support.
change: 为均匀/正态随机调用传入 seed；用 softmax、均匀样本和 multinomial_from_uniform 组合多项采样。
Adds seeded uniform/normal calls and composes multinomial sampling from existing Relax operations.
scope: 保留旧无种子调用兼容；支持种子不代表与 TFLite 随机序列逐比特一致。
Keeps unseeded compatibility; seed support is not a claim of bit-exact TFLite random sequences.

problem: 分段求和、最小值和乘积缺少 TFLite 到 Relax 的映射。
Several TFLite segment reductions lacked Relax mappings.
change: 统一构造 scatter 索引、输出形状与各归约的单位元，用 scatter_nd 承担 add/min/mul。
Builds scatter indices, output shapes and reduction identities for add/min/multiply modes.
scope: 结构测试检查归约模式和初始化；正确单位元是空 segment 行为的重要部分。
IR tests inspect modes and initialization; identities matter for empty segments.

problem: 手写 importer 测试难以系统覆盖 ONNX 官方规范的边界输入。
Handwritten importer tests did not systematically cover official ONNX edge cases.
change: 实现 ONNX Backend 适配器，串起导入、降级、编译与 VM 执行，以明确 allowlist 接入官方测试。
Adds a backend adapter from import through VM execution and an explicit allowlist for the official suite.
scope: 未覆盖项仍跳过；PR 报告的 388 个通过用例不是 ONNX 全量支持，也不等于已接入全部 CI。
The reported 388 passing cases are a bounded subset, not full ONNX coverage or every CI suite.

problem: TFLite 中的 StableHLO builtin 使用独立元数据，不适合硬套普通 QNN/激活转换。
StableHLO builtins use metadata distinct from ordinary TFLite quantized operations.
change: 增加独立 unary/binary/ternary helpers 和 BuiltinOptions2 解析，接入 29 个初始算子子集。
Adds dedicated helpers and BuiltinOptions2 parsing for an initial 29-operator subset.
scope: PAD、GATHER、动态切片等有明确子集限制；算子出现在列表中不代表支持所有属性组合。
PAD, GATHER and slicing retain explicit subset restrictions rather than supporting every attribute combination.

problem: 前端遇到量化元数据就拒绝导入，残留 QNN 调用也不可达或无有效实现。
Quantization metadata blocked import before incomplete QNN paths could run.
change: 保留 scale、zero point 与量化轴，将支持路径表达为反量化 → 浮点 Relax 算子 → 再量化。
Preserves scales, zero points and axes, lowering supported operations through explicit float QDQ decomposition.
scope: QDQ 首先打通导入与执行；不等同原生全整数 Kernel，也不能由此声称 INT8 加速。
Establishes an import path, not native all-integer kernels or an INT8 speedup claim.

problem: 区域算子引用子图，原来只接受单子图的导入器无法表示这些结构。
Region operators reference subgraphs that the single-subgraph importer could not represent.
change: 允许主图与附属 region 共存，补充 10 个 StableHLO 算子子集，并让各 converter 按需消费 region。
Adds multi-subgraph infrastructure and ten additional StableHLO operator subsets with on-demand region handling.
scope: 仍只将主图作为 main；DOT/卷积/更新切片等按限定结构支持，不把任意子图全部执行。
Only the main graph becomes main; matrix, convolution and update patterns remain constrained.

problem: CALL、IF、WHILE 需要子图调用与循环状态，不能简单逐算子展开。
CALL, IF and WHILE require subgraph calls and loop-carried state.
change: 共享子图转换状态，将纯张量区域降为私有 Relax 函数，用 If 与递归函数表达分支和循环。
Lowers pure-tensor regions to private Relax functions, using If and recursion for control flow.
scope: CALL_ONCE 此阶段只支持空初始化；一般资源副作用不被当成纯函数偷偷导入。
At this stage CALL_ONCE supports empty initialization only; general resource side effects remain rejected.

problem: 资源变量与静态表的初始化在 CALL_ONCE 子图中，主图需要正确解析同一逻辑资源。
CALL_ONCE initialization and the main graph must resolve the same resources and static tables.
change: 加入共享资源初始化状态与句柄解析，处理变量赋值/读取，并支持静态 hashtable 导入及大小信息。
Adds shared initialization state, handle resolution, variable reads and static-table import/size handling.
scope: 以最终 diff 为准：描述早期文本仍写 hashtable 未支持；运行时可变状态和字符串查询没有被全面实现。
The final diff goes beyond the early body text; general mutable state and runtime string lookup remain unsupported.

problem: StableHLO WHILE 的条件与 body 索引放在不同 options 中，尚未接入已有循环降级。
StableHLO WHILE stores region references in a different options structure.
change: 抽出共享 while helper，解析 BuiltinOptions2 后复用私有函数与递归循环，并校验循环状态和 bool 条件。
Parses those options and reuses shared recursive lowering with loop-state and scalar-bool checks.
scope: 复用纯张量循环契约；区分 native 与 StableHLO 缓存键，避免两种包装错误共用。
Uses the pure-tensor contract and distinct cache keys for native and StableHLO wrappers.

problem: 任意 custom call 没有可知的执行语义，直接映射会凭空赋予行为。
Arbitrary custom calls have no known executable semantics in this importer.
change: 仅把无副作用、单输入输出且类型形状一致的 Sharding 注释消除为 identity，其他 target 明确拒绝。
Erases only validated, side-effect-free Sharding annotations to identity and rejects other targets.
scope: 这是注释处理，不是通用 custom-call 执行器，也不保留多设备 sharding 执行语义。
Annotation handling, not a generic custom-call runtime or distributed execution support.

problem: 随机位生成器要求状态与输出逐比特匹配，不能替换成任意随机算子。
The random-bit generator requires exact state and output semantics.
change: 用 TIR 实现 Threefry/Philox 的轮函数、计数器推进和输出打包，返回随机位及更新后的 uint64 状态。
Implements Threefry/Philox rounds, counter updates and word packing in TIR, returning bits and updated state.
scope: 算法、dtype 和状态长度均有限定；这是确定性随机位契约，不与普通随机分布算子混同。
Algorithms, dtypes and state lengths are explicitly bounded; distinct from generic random-distribution support.

problem: Relax 没有原生 complex64 表示，TFLite RFFT2D 需要配套输出表示和计算降级。
RFFT2D needed a complex-output representation and compute lowering in Relax.
change: 用尾维大小 2 表示实虚部；根据空间维度选择 radix-2 FFT 或 DFT 参考 TIR Kernel。
Represents real/imaginary pairs on a trailing dimension and dispatches to radix-2 FFT or reference DFT TIR.
scope: 仅静态、无 padding/截断的 float32 路径；非二次幂 DFT 的正确性支持不等于高性能 FFT。
Static float32 with no padding/truncation; the non-power-of-two DFT fallback is not a high-performance FFT claim.

problem: 多个 builtin 缺少映射，FAKE_QUANT 还调用不存在的 const API。
Several builtins lacked mappings and FAKE_QUANT called an invalid constant API.
change: 复用 Relax 算子补充符号、位运算、bucketize、unique 和 segment 映射，并修正 FAKE_QUANT 常量构造。
Adds mappings through existing Relax operators and repairs FAKE_QUANT constant construction.
scope: 这是前端转换与回归；没有为每个新增映射编写独立底层 Kernel。
Frontend conversion and regression work, not separate new kernels for every mapped operation.

problem: REVERSE_SEQUENCE 把 TE 计算当成运行时 packed 函数调用，结构可导入却未形成合法执行路径。
REVERSE_SEQUENCE treated a TE compute as a runtime packed function.
change: 注册正式 Relax reverse_sequence 并经 LegalizeOps 降到 TIR；补齐 squeeze、unpack、zeros_like 与 VM 覆盖。
Adds a registered Relax operator legalized to TIR, alongside missing importer tests and VM coverage.
scope: 明确区分 IR 结构测试与实际编译执行，避免把函数名存在当作运行时可调用。
Separates structural import tests from actual compile/run checks.

problem: DELEGATE 等标记不是普通张量算子，通用 unsupported 报错无法说明原因。
Delegate/schema markers are not ordinary tensor operators.
change: 识别两个 schema/委托标记，路由到明确的 marker 诊断并补充拒绝路径测试。
Recognizes both markers and adds targeted diagnostics with rejection tests.
scope: 增加的是可解释报错，不是执行 DELEGATE 或支持任意外部 delegate。
Improves errors; it does not execute arbitrary delegates.

problem: 旧 embedding、字符串和 hash 算子没有可靠 Relax 语义，泛化报错难区分坏模型与未支持功能。
Legacy embedding, string and hash operators lack sound Relax semantics.
change: 为 CONCAT_EMBEDDINGS、LSH_PROJECTION 和 SKIP_GRAM 增加选项/元数据检查与专用拒绝诊断。
Adds option/metadata validation and targeted rejection diagnostics for three legacy builtins.
scope: 本条未合并；同主题见 #19860。所谓 coverage 指识别和验证，不是成功执行这些算子。
Unmerged; see #19860 for the same topic. Coverage means recognition and validation, not execution.

problem: 遗留 embedding 算子需要明确说明哪些元数据合法、哪些核心语义仍缺失。
Legacy embedding operators need precise metadata and unsupported-semantics diagnostics.
change: 解析三个 legacy builtin 的参数、形状和类型，然后给出字符串或 fingerprint hash 等缺失能力的诊断。
Validates their options, shapes and types before reporting missing string/hash behavior.
scope: 测试预期是针对性拒绝；不会把新增 handler 数量当成新增可执行算子数量。
Tests expect targeted rejection; more handlers do not mean more executable operators.

problem: RANGE 的运行时起点、终点和步长无法直接传入仅接受编译期边界的 arange。
Runtime RANGE bounds could not be passed directly to compile-time arange bounds.
change: 在图中先求元素个数，将其提升为输出维度，再用 arange(0,L)×delta+start 重建值，支持升序和降序。
Computes element count in the graph, lifts it to a dimension and reconstructs values from arange(0,L).
scope: 常量路径保持不变；计数先行用于确保推导长度与运行结果一致，而不是单纯解除 guard。
Preserves the constant path and aligns inferred/runtime lengths, including descending ranges.

problem: 缺少字符串张量与运行时哈希表时，动态查表不能安全映射为一般张量算子。
Runtime string lookup cannot be represented without string tensors and a hashtable runtime.
change: 解析常量字符串 buffer，保存 CALL_ONCE 导入的键值，在查询也是常量时于导入阶段折叠为 Relax 常量。
Decodes constant string buffers and folds lookups over statically initialized keys/values during import.
scope: 仅可常量折叠的查表子集；重复键和运行时字符串查询受到明确限制。
Limited to constant-foldable queries, with explicit duplicate-key and dynamic-query restrictions.

problem: DYNAMIC_UPDATE_SLICE 的动态 start 被拒绝，运行时计算偏移的模型无法导入。
Runtime start indices prevented DYNAMIC_UPDATE_SLICE import.
change: 在图内按轴 clamp start、生成广播索引网格，再复用 scatter_nd 更新原张量。
Clamps starts and builds broadcast index grids in the graph, reusing scatter_nd for updates.
scope: 动态路径使用 StableHLO 的越界夹取语义；不新增算子，静态路径仍保留原检查。
Uses StableHLO clamping for dynamic starts while preserving the existing static path.

problem: 动态整数除数含零时，LLVM 可能触发整数除零崩溃。
A dynamic zero integer divisor could cause an LLVM division trap.
change: 先把零除数替成 1 以安全求商，再将原零位置输出设为 0；非零整数结果保持原语义。
Substitutes a safe divisor before division and returns zero on originally zero lanes.
scope: ONNX 整数除零未定义，零输出是此实现的确定性策略；常量零除数仍在导入时拒绝。
Zero output is this implementation’s policy for undefined ONNX behavior; constant zero divisors remain rejected.

problem: 官方 ONNX 测试中的 CastLike 与动态 k Trilu 暴露前端支持缺口。
Official ONNX cases exposed missing CastLike and dynamic-k Trilu handling.
change: 根据第二输入 dtype 实现 CastLike，去除 Trilu 的常量 k 限制，并扩展官方节点测试 allowlist。
Adds dtype-driven CastLike, dynamic Trilu and a wider node-test allowlist.
scope: 通过数提升属于选定测试范围；仍排除名称碰撞的模型测试，不等同所有 ONNX 后端用例通过。
Coverage gains apply to the selected suite, not every ONNX backend case.

problem: 部分转换仍调用已移除或不存在的 cast API，导致前端路径报错。
Some converters called removed or nonexistent cast APIs.
change: 将 FLOAT16 DEQUANTIZE 与量化 avgpool 内部转换改为 relax.op.astype，并补充针对性测试。
Uses relax.op.astype for FLOAT16 dequantization and the internal quantized-avgpool path with targeted tests.
scope: 该 PR 没有在顶层启用量化 avgpool；PR 还记录了无关的 broadcast_to 全文件测试失败。
Does not enable top-level quantized avgpool; the PR also records an unrelated full-file test failure.

problem: StableHLO reshape、slice、transpose 尚未接入当前前端，已有贡献还需适配 review。
Three StableHLO shape mappings needed integration and review follow-up.
change: 接续 @Mohxen 的 #19869 实现，在当前主线补上三个映射及显式输入输出数量校验。
Carries forward @Mohxen’s #19869 implementation and adds explicit input/output arity checks on current main.
scope: 保留原作者贡献归属；支持静态 shape/属性子集，不能把接续工作写成全部独立原创。
Preserves original authorship and static-subset limits rather than claiming sole original implementation.

problem: 合法的低 rank PRelu slope 按尾维广播，却被要求与输入同 rank 的 converter 拒绝。
Valid lower-rank PRelu slopes were rejected despite trailing-dimension broadcasting.
change: 对齐 slope 的非广播维到输入轴，reshape 为 Relax 可表达的一维 slope，并处理 rank-zero 情况。
Maps the non-broadcast slope dimension to the input axis and reshapes to Relax’s one-dimensional slope form.
scope: 仍拒绝多个非广播维的 slope；结构与 ONNX Runtime 数值回归覆盖可表示子集。
Multiple non-broadcast dimensions remain unsupported; structural and numerical tests cover the representable subset.

problem: 零维张量没有有效轴，但 per-tensor QDQ 本来不应依赖 axis。
Rank-zero tensors have no valid axis, while per-tensor QDQ should not require one.
change: 对标量输入跳过轴范围检查，同时要求标量或单元素 scale/zero point；保持高 rank 校验不变。
Skips scalar axis checks only with scalar/singleton quantization parameters, preserving higher-rank rules.
scope: 修复核心类型推导并补 ONNX 数值与 dtype 回归；不放宽 per-axis 量化约束。
Core inference and ONNX numerical/dtype coverage do not relax per-axis quantization constraints.

problem: 量化 SSD 的类别、分数与 depthwise 权重布局处理不一致，导致检测结果错误。
Quantized SSD had inconsistent class, score and depthwise-weight conversion.
change: 去掉可选背景类别和重复 softmax，接通 pooling QDQ，并在重排前按原通道轴反量化 depthwise 权重。
Removes optional background/double softmax, enables pooling QDQ and dequantizes depthwise weights before layout conversion.
scope: 保留通用算子默认行为；仍是 QDQ 路径，低置信度框可能重排，不宣称完整整数语义或性能提升。
Preserves generic defaults; remains a QDQ path with possible low-confidence reordering, not a full-integer speedup claim.
